title: qa.request.v1
description: Phase 7 §7.1: sanitized QA text consumed by the Phase 10 NLP layer. Two producers (Go gateway on `pass`; sec.input.v1 on post-classifier `pass`) are mutually exclusive per `request_id` (ROADMAP §7.5 binding); NLP must dedup on `request_id` over `cfg.qa_request_v1_dedup_window_s`. Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::QaRequestV1`.

sanitized_text.description: Post-NFC, post-control-strip text. Original raw bytes are NOT carried here; quarantine forensics live on `sec.quarantine.v1`.

locale.description: Language locale (§10.17). v1 ships tr-TR only; designed to additively gain en-GB/en-US post-Phase-13a.

answer_format.description: Requested answer output format (§10.23.7). Optional at v1; defaults to plain when absent.

sec_verdict.description: `pass` = no transform; `sanitized` = deterministic transform applied (NFC, strip control / zero-width / RTL, optional homoglyph fold).

sec_steps_run.description: Ordered audit trail of which deterministic / classifier steps fired.

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation identifier for multi-turn follow-up context.

input_source.description: Optional request metadata hint for the input source; voice enables ASR-tolerant normalization paths.
